groups.title: Right now: what is on
groups.note: Green: the function is on. Red: it is off. No colour: a mode, not an on/off switch. Change any of them on Controls.

sections.title: Reading this dashboard
text: Green means a function is on: backup enabled, an export or output limit in force, solar limited, the inverter running, a forced charge or discharge under way.
Red means it is off: disabled, stopped, solar allowed, the inverter shut down. A mode such as EMS mode has no colour: it is a choice, not on or off.
not reported: the device has not answered that register yet. unavailable: no fresh reading for three of its read intervals (at least 30 s).
The dot at the top right is green while the house power keeps arriving, and red with the minutes since it stopped.
Every setting is written, then read back from the device; the box shows what the device kept. If it refuses, the reason appears beside the box.

sections.title: Units
text: Power in kW to 3 decimals (the inverter's 1 W resolution), energy in kWh to 1 decimal (the registers count 0.1 kWh), and the cell spread in mV, the only mV figure.

sections.title: Something wrong?
text: Settings → System → Logs, search sungrow_sh_t: a refused register, a lost connection or a slow read is named there.
If the dot at the top is red, the Logger is not answering: check it is powered and on the network.
Report it at the integration's issues, with the log lines.
